summary: Iteration 114 — Validated PHASE 2 SCORM 1.2 single-page export end-to-end. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_scorm_singlepage_api.py (9 new API/contract tests) and extended /app/backend/tests/test_scorm_singlepage_e2e.py with one additional real-browser E2E test for end-card completion. Combined run: 15/15 passing in 19s. Coverage: (a) override hierarchy — body.singlePage=true → mode='single_page' + filename contains _singlepage_, body.singlePage=false → mode='traditional' even when project.singlePageMode=true, empty body falls back to project.singlePageMode (both true and false branches verified); (b) ZIP contents — all 7 required files present (imsmanifest.xml, index.html, scorm-api.js, adlcp_rootv1p2.xsd, ims_xml.xsd, imscp_rootv1p1p2.xsd, imsmd_rootv1p2p1.xsd); (c) imsmanifest.xml declares scormtype=sco, schemaversion 1.2, references index.html + scorm-api.js, includes adlcp namespace; (d) index.html has SCORM_MODE=true + script tag for scorm-api.js + all 5 helpers (scormSaveState/Report/UpdateScore/MarkComplete/RestoreState); (e) scorm-api.js exposes all 9 required methods (init, setLocation, saveSuspend, getSuspend, recordInteraction, setScore, complete, commit, finish) + findAPI walker; (f) regression test for the advance() ordering bug: regex inspection asserts state.currentIndex assignment appears BEFORE unlockSection() inside advance(); (g) E2E in real chromium with mock LMS confirms — SCORM.init() sets cmi.core.lesson_status='incomplete', SP.advance() updates cmi.core.lesson_location='1' AND cmi.suspend_data with currentIndex=1 + unlocked={0,1}, reload restores unlocked sections 0..2 from suspend_data, advancing past last section calls window.SCORM.complete() and LMS receives lesson_status in (passed|completed). Frontend wiring confirmed by code inspection: ProjectContext.exportScorm(options={singlePage}) forwards in POST body, useEditorExport.handleExport reads currentProject.singlePageMode. ExportDialog single-page-toggle was already validated live in iteration_113. ENV NOTE: MongoDB hit a WT_PANIC No-space-left mid-iteration because the /app 9.8G ext4 partition (which also hosts /data/db) filled from accumulated SCORM ZIPs + 502M node_modules/.cache + 849M /app/.git; freed disk + supervisorctl restart mongodb (recovered cleanly via WAL replay, no data loss).

minor.issue: MongoDB WT_PANIC No-space-left during heavy export testing. _cleanup_old_exports keeps 24h which fills disk faster than retention under sustained testing. Recommend tighter retention or moving exports to overlay (84G free).

critical_code_review_comments: scorm_single_page_exporter.py + single_page_exporter.py share zero duplicated logic — clean inheritance via the scorm_mode boolean, good DRY.
advance() ordering fix (state.currentIndex BEFORE unlockSection) is structurally correct and now regression-protected by both a static regex test and a real-browser E2E test.

scormMarkComplete uses Object.keys(state.unlocked).length >= (SECTIONS.length + 1) which correctly counts the end-card. Quiz pass-mark hardcoded to 80% — plumb through if user-config exists for mastery threshold.
Mock LMS fixture is intentionally minimal (no LMSGetLastError state machine). Sufficient for SP→API contract testing; full SCORM 1.2 conformance must be validated in SCORM Cloud or Moodle.

Frontend ProjectContext.exportScorm + useEditorExport.handleExport correctly forward singlePage from project setting via fetch body. data-testid='single-page-toggle' is shared between SCORM and HTML — clean.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — code inspection confirms exportScorm({singlePage}) wiring; UI toggle validated live in iter 113
